headline: Swings to a large quarterly loss
summary_short: The company posted a consolidated operating loss of KRW 502.2B and a net loss to owners of KRW 394.1B, against a KRW 340.4B profit a year earlier.
summary_long: Third-party coverage of the preliminary filing reports a consolidated net loss after a quarter that was profitable a year ago. Yahoo EPS of KRW -689 compares with KRW 3,279 last quarter. Separate-entity operating profit was KRW 178.8B. Nine-month figures remain profitable. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary results; sources disagree on the Q3 2025 revenue base, and revenue is not shown. EPS is Yahoo data.
